heroHeadline: Day 967: Haredi Bloc Uses October 7 Probe as Coalition Leverage; IDF Shuts Hostages HQ After 846 Days; 31 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Accountability Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 31, 2026 (Day 967 / Ceasefire Day 234): Haredi (ultra-Orthodox) coalition parties threatened to support an independent October 7 probe unless the coalition advanced the ultra-Orthodox daycare subsidy bill — a striking use of accountability demands as political leverage that highlights the degree to which the 1,195 victims' families' demands have been captured by coalition horse-trading. Knesset dissolution is advancing (preliminary vote 110–0, May 20); early elections are expected within five months. The Kallner inquiry bill — stripped of 'independent investigation' language, barring judges — still needs three more plenum readings, making it almost certainly unpassable before elections. Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara called the Kallner bill 'tailor-made for the government's personal needs.' May 30, 2026 (Day 966): The IDF formally shut down its Hostages and Missing Persons HQ — 846 days after October 7 — after all 251 hostages were fully accounted for (168 returned alive; 83–85 bodies repatriated; last remains, Ran Gvili, recovered Jan 26, 2026). Bereaved Nova festival mother Reut Recht-Edri publicly accused coalition MKs of 'demeaning the dead' at a protest outside the Knesset; 32 days remained to the July 1 deadline at that time. May 29 (Day 965): Imad Aqel — Hamas logistics and tunnel-infrastructure commander — identified as sole surviving senior Hamas figure from October 7 planning circle; no new Qassam Brigades supreme commander announced since Odeh's killing. The NILI task force continues operations. 3,005+ ceasefire violations documented; 857+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire began October 10, 2025. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Israel Police, UN OCHA, Israeli government, Bloomberg, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, Times of Israel, Jerusalem Post, Washington Post, Al Jazeera, WSJ, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are official Israeli counts; Hamas-theater figures are separately noted and contested. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. Ceasefire in effect since Oct 10, 2025; 3,005+ violations documented — 857+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire (Day 234 as of May 31). October 7 Perpetrators Eliminated: Sinwar (Oct 16, 2024), Shambari (Apr 29, 2026), Haddad (May 16, 2026), Odeh (May 27, 2026). Last survivor: Imad Aqel (NILI target). Accountability: Kallner bill in flux; 31 days to July 1 deadline; Beyachad pledges Day-1 state commission; early elections looming.
